name: Okusama
source:
"Welcome, [url=/c34812]Taro[/url]... I personally welcome you."

The mysterious mother of the four sisters and the owner of the mansion. Nobody knows what she is doing for most of the time. Half of her face is hidden behind her veil which makes it hard to see her expressions.
